registries.purpose: Pinned source-asset cooking and validation dependencies

rules: No runtime, authoring, asset, or tool dependency may bypass the Root Project Control Center source gate.
Every network source must use HTTPS, carry an explicit license, and identify an immutable version/revision.
Normal build/test never downloads arbitrary dependencies directly.
Fetched bytes enter a project-local quarantine/cache first and are promoted only after hash/provenance/certification checks.
Full Gate records source/dependency evidence and fails closed for required sources that cannot be certified.
Third-party source archives are never treated as authoritative project source; normalized/cooked derivatives are generated from governed inputs.
